title: Guarantee Premium Basis for Years Upgraded to Plus
content:
On Northgate Memberships the Plus premium covered by the Plus guarantee for a completed year — the guarantee premium basis — depends on how the completed year was held at Plus. The Plus premium is 65.00 dollars on Northgate Club Plus Membership and on Northgate Business Plus Membership, and 0.00 on every other tier (Northgate Student Club Membership, Northgate Heroes Club Membership, Northgate Club Membership, Northgate Business Membership).

**Rule.** When an upgrade difference fee was charged for the completed year and the membership was held at Plus for at least three months of it, the guarantee premium basis is the Plus premium multiplied by the months held at Plus and divided by twelve, rounded to the cent, the months held being the whole months from the upgrade date to the end of the year plus one for the month of the upgrade. When an upgrade difference fee was charged for the completed year and the membership was held at Plus for fewer than three months of it, the guarantee premium basis is zero. A year held at Plus from its first day has the full Plus premium as its guarantee premium basis.

The guarantee shortfall is the guarantee premium basis less the Annual Reward earned for the completed year, rounded to the cent.

**Reading the records.** An upgrade difference fee was charged for the completed year when the ledger holds an upgrade difference charge for the membership year ending on that year's end date; the upgrade date is the date of that charge (the latest, if more than one). Whole months from the upgrade date to the end of the year count a month only when the year-end's day of the month has reached the upgrade date's day of the month.

## Decision table

| Upgrade difference fee charged for the completed year | Months held at Plus | Guarantee premium basis |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3 or more | Plus premium multiplied by months held, divided by twelve, rounded to the cent |
| Yes | fewer than 3 | zero |
| No — held at Plus from the first day | 12 | the full Plus premium |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; year ending 31 December 2027, Plus premium 65.00)

| Upgrade date | Whole months to 31 December | Months held | Guarantee premium basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 August 2027 | 4 | 5 | 65.00 multiplied by 5, divided by twelve: 27.08 |
| 1 October 2027 | 2 | 3 | 65.00 multiplied by 3, divided by twelve: 16.25 |
| 15 November 2027 | 1 | 2 | zero |
| none — Plus all year | — | 12 | 65.00 |
